name: alphafold-sovereign-mcp
description: MCP server wrapping AlphaFold DB and 8 other biomedical data sources.
scientific_validation_note: Engineering-validated: 100% line and branch coverage, measured on tests that answer every upstream request from mocked or recorded responses. The test suite does not call the live upstream APIs; one narrow live check (a PDBe/SIFTS residue correspondence) runs when its files change or on manual dispatch. No end-to-end validation against real-world cases has been performed. Scientific outputs (ACMG draft, druggability tier) have NOT been reviewed by independent domain experts. Not yet deployed in production. See STATUS.md and LIMITATIONS.md.
